query: WITH spesa_per_cliente AS (SELECT c.id, c.nome, SUM(o.importo_totale) AS totale_speso FROM clienti c JOIN ordini o ON c.id = o.cliente_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome) SELECT c.nome, COALESCE(spc.totale_speso, 0) AS totale_speso, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ordini o WHERE o.cliente_id = c.id) AS numero_ordini FROM clienti c LEFT OUTER JOIN spesa_per_cliente spc ON c.id = spc.id ORDER BY totale_speso DESC LIMIT 5;
